description: Main source code for SPI flash memory operations on a Microchip device using Zephyr RTOS, including reading, writing, erasing, and verifying flash memory contents.

methods.name: is_data_buf_filled_with
methods.description: Checks if a data buffer is filled with a specific value.

methods.name: spi_flash_format_addr
methods.description: Formats a 32-bit SPI address into a byte buffer.

methods.name: spi_flash_read_status
methods.description: Reads status register from SPI flash device.

methods.name: spi_poll_busy
methods.description: Polls SPI flash device until it is not busy or timeout occurs.

methods.name: spi_flash_fd_wr_cpd
methods.description: Performs full-duplex write of command, parameters, and data to SPI flash.

methods.name: spi_flash_read_fd_sync
methods.description: Performs synchronous full-duplex read from SPI flash.

methods.name: spi_flash_read_hd_sync
methods.description: Performs dual or quad mode synchronous read from SPI flash.

methods.name: spi_flash_erase_region
methods.description: Erases a region of SPI flash memory.
